parties.respondent: Kalsammanavara Kalamma (Since Dead) By Legal Heirs & Ors.

summary: Amendment of plaint allowed in appeal for alternative possession claim; continuation of proceedings principle under CPC; Order 6 Rule 17 CPC and Section 107(2) CPC applicability; title established negates limitation defense absent adverse possession plea; Article 58 vs. Article 55 Limitation Act distinction; First Appellate Court reversal confirmed; HC dismissal of second appeal set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; First Appellate Court decree restored.
